name: Engineering Metrology, Offline Security & Licensing Hardening
summary: Pro3DWorks v3.2.6 strengthens mirrored-part CNC and printability geometry transforms, active-unit report and CSV exports, STEP AP242 and DXF parser resilience, strict clinical no-cache and air-gapped enterprise policy isolation, command-palette accuracy, and online/Stripe license revocation and seat reliability.

highlights.title: Mirrored-Part CNC Readiness & Printability Geometry Transforms
highlights.text: Preserves accurate winding, face normals, pocket accessibility, overhang angles, and wall-thickness sampling across mirrored assembly occurrences and negative-determinant world transforms.

highlights.title: Active-Unit Report & CSV Export Consistency
highlights.text: Keeps Review Report HTML packages, RFQ material summaries, tolerance stack-ups, draft angle tables, and revision comparisons aligned with active display units, complete traceability fields, and clean empty-section suppression.

highlights.title: STEP AP242 PMI & Waterjet DXF Parser Resilience
highlights.text: Hardens bounded STEP AP242 semantic and graphical PMI extraction and Waterjet 2D Studio DXF preflight geometry parsing against edge-case entities, nested blocks, and unit scaling without external network dependencies.

highlights.title: Clinical No-Cache Privacy & Air-Gapped Enterprise Policy Isolation
highlights.text: Enforces machine-level registry and ProgramData policy precedence with fail-closed unreadable-policy protection, clinical no-cache session hygiene, and redacted error diagnostics that never expose local paths or license tokens.

highlights.title: Command-Palette Accuracy & Licensing Seat Reliability
highlights.text: Refines deterministic local command matching and guarded step execution while hardening online and Stripe seat activation, revocation refresh synchronization, and offline signed license file import.

notes: All CAD geometry, RFQ intake, CNC DFM, DXF preflight, Release Review reconciliation, PDF-to-DXF/DWG conversions, and GPU renders run locally on your workstation — zero customer model uploads.
Managed offline mode ('no_external_network') provides technical egress controls and is not a claim of organizational ISO/IEC 27001 certification or TISAX assessment.
OpenCascade / occt-import-js (LGPL-2.1) is shipped in separate relinkable desktop files alongside LICENSE.md; see docs/SBOM.cdx.json.
